entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_system_01

entries.text: 謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳叫了這麼多的人\n來藍莓學園。[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這麼幫忙，\n我得送[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳特別的禮物才行！[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_02

entries.text: 那就是和藍莓學園的\n……[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]幕後老大[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]對戰的權利！[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_03

entries.text: 那麼，請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳現在就到入口來。[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_04

entries.text: 他也很期待見到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢。\n……那麼，等會兒見！[VAR 0x0114(0054)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳怎麼在這裡？\n在等誰嗎？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_07

entries.text: 幕後老大……
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_01

entries.text: 我是被叫來的……
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_02

entries.text: 這樣啊，這樣啊！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_08

entries.text: 那麼，\n我差不多該公布答案了！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_09

entries.text: 哇，想不到吧！\n其實我就是番紅～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_10

entries.text: 託[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的福，\n學園裡的很多人\r\n還有很多社團，都充滿了活力喔。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_11

entries.text: 我身為校長，\n真的非常感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。\r\n實在是太感激了。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_12

entries.text: 然後，我這個校長……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_13

entries.text: 正是藍莓學園最強的\n……幕後老大！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_14

entries.text: 如果說檯面上最強的是\n藍莓聯盟的冠軍，\r\n那麼幕後老大就是檯面下最強的傢伙了。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_15

entries.text: 對手是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話，\n或許我可以對戰得很開心。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_16

entries.text: 那麼，事不宜遲，\n我們就開始吧……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_17

entries.text: 我會拿出真本事的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要撐久一點啊～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_18

entries.text: 哎呀～[VAR 0x0100(0000)]～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好強啊！\n我這幾十年都沒被打輸過呢～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_19

entries.text: 哎呀～藍莓聯盟冠軍\n連幕後老大都打倒了的話，那……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_20

entries.text: 該怎麼稱呼才好呢？\n嗯～……藍莓王之類的？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_21

entries.text: 該怎麼稱呼才好呢？\n嗯～……藍莓女王之類的？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_21b

entries.text: 真不錯！
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_03

entries.text: 聽起來有點……
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_select_04

entries.text: 算了，稱呼不重要！\n總之恭喜[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_22

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打倒了幕後老大，\n我要送[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳特別獎。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_23

entries.text: 總覺得心情很好，\n想再多送[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一點東西～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_00

entries.text: ……對了！\n我們來交換寶可夢如何？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_01

entries.text: 我會拿斑斑馬出來。\n我們來交換寶可夢吧！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_02

entries.text: 是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢的話，\n不論是哪個孩子我都舉雙手歡迎喔～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊～！嗯！
真棒！謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！\c
我的斑斑馬顏色很稀有，
很厲害吧～！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要好好珍惜喔～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_01_04

entries.text: 用[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的斑斑馬交換，可以嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_02_03

entries.text:
哎呀，話說回來
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳只有１隻寶可夢啊……\c
這樣也能打遍天下的確很厲害，
但是要有２隻以上的寶可夢才能交換喔！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_03_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想交換的時候，\n就再找我，然後打贏我吧。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_trade_03_01

entries.text: 那麼，再見啦～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_first_24

entries.text: 那麼，事不宜遲，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳快來入口吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_01

entries.text: 藍莓王駕到囉～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_02

entries.text: 藍莓女王駕到囉～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_02b

entries.text: 那麼，事不宜遲，\n我們就開始吧……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_03

entries.text: 我會全力奪取勝利的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可別輸了喔～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_04

entries.text: 果然最強的藍莓王\n應該是我才對～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想對戰的時候，\n就再找我吧～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_06

entries.text: 呼～真有趣！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然很強呢～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_07

entries.text: 這是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打贏我的獎勵，\n就交給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳囉～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_08

entries.text: ……對了！結果上次\n我們沒有交換寶可夢呢！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_09

entries.text: 那麼，再見啦～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: coach_bbteacher_head_second_10
